items.label: Create LiveSticky Dashboard
items.description: Creates a persistent custom post dashboard that auto-updates with live stream stats and platform links.

items.label: Restart LiveSticky
items.description: Clears cached stream status and runs an immediate status check.

items.label: Refresh Profile Images
items.description: Clears the cached avatar and banner URLs and re-fetches them from the platform API immediately.

items.label: Get Default LiveSticky Templates
items.description: Opens the GitHub page with copy-pasteable templates for your settings.

enableDashboard.label: 📊 Enable Custom Post Dashboard
enableDashboard.helpText: If enabled, LiveSticky will power a persistent interactive dashboard post.

enableLivePost.label: 📝 Enable Live Text Post
enableLivePost.helpText: If enabled, automatically creates and pins a standard text post when the stream goes live.

updateSidebarWidget.label: 📱 Enable Sidebar Widget
updateSidebarWidget.helpText: Creates and automatically updates a "Stream Status" text widget in your community sidebar.

primaryPlatform.label: 👑 Primary Platform
primaryPlatform.helpText: This platform will always appear at the top of the multistream dashboard.

customAvatarUrl.label: 👑 Custom Avatar Image URL (Optional)
customAvatarUrl.helpText: Override your profile picture with a DIRECT Reddit image link (i.redd.it/…). Upload an image to Reddit, then copy its direct link. Leave blank to auto-fetch from your primary platform.

streamerRedditUsername.label: 👤 Streamer Reddit Username (Optional)
streamerRedditUsername.helpText: The exact Reddit username of the streamer (without the u/). Used for User Flair updates.

liveUserFlairText.label: 👤 Live User Flair Text (Optional)
liveUserFlairText.helpText: The User Flair text applied to the Streamer when they go live.

offlineUserFlairText.label: 👤 Offline User Flair Text (Optional)
offlineUserFlairText.helpText: The User Flair text applied to the Streamer when they go offline. Leave blank to clear their flair completely.

twitchChannel.label: 🟪 Twitch Channel Name (Optional)
twitchChannel.helpText: The name of the Twitch channel to monitor (e.g., streamer)

twitchClientId.label: 🟪 Twitch Client ID (Optional)
twitchClientId.helpText: Your Twitch App Client ID. Register one at https://dev.twitch.tv/console (Guide: https://livesticky.com/setup.html). Sensitive - only mods of this community can see it.

twitchClientSecret.label: 🟪 Twitch Client Secret (Optional)
twitchClientSecret.helpText: Your Twitch App Client Secret. Sensitive - keep it confidential; only mods of this community can see it. (Guide: https://livesticky.com/setup.html)

youtubeChannel.label: 🟥 YouTube Channel Name / Handle (Optional)
youtubeChannel.helpText: The name or handle of your YouTube channel (e.g., @ChannelName or ChannelName)

youtubeApiKey.label: 🟥 YouTube Data API Key (Optional)
youtubeApiKey.helpText: Your Google Developer API Key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Required if using YouTube Live status check. Sensitive - only mods of this community can see it.
youtubeApiKey.placeholder: your YouTube Data API v3 key

kickChannel.label: 🟩 Kick Channel Name (Optional)
kickChannel.helpText: The name of your Kick channel (e.g., ChannelName)

kickClientId.label: 🟩 Kick API Client ID (Optional)
kickClientId.helpText: Your Kick Developer API Client ID. Required if using Kick status check. Sensitive - only mods of this community can see it.

kickClientSecret.label: 🟩 Kick API Client Secret (Optional)
kickClientSecret.helpText: Your Kick Developer API Client Secret. Required if using Kick status check. Sensitive - only mods of this community can see it.

placeholderReference.label: ℹ️ Available Placeholders (for reference)
placeholderReference.defaultValue:
{channel} - Twitch channel login name (e.g. streamer)
{display_name} - Channel display name (e.g. Streamer)
{title} - Stream title
{game} - Game or category being streamed (live only)
{viewers} - Current viewer count (live only)
{uptime} - How long the stream has been live (live only)
{date} - Date the stream ended (post-stream only)
{twitch_url} - Twitch channel URL
{youtube_url} - YouTube channel URL
{kick_url} - Kick channel URL

dashboardPostTitle.label: 📺 Dashboard Post Title (Optional)
dashboardPostTitle.helpText: Custom title for the persistent dashboard post. If empty, the default is used.

livePostTitle.label: 🔴 Live Post Title (Optional)
livePostTitle.helpText: Custom title for the live post. If empty, the default template is used.

livePostBody.label: 🔴 Live Post Body (Markdown) (Optional)
livePostBody.helpText: Custom markdown for the body of the live post. If empty, the default template is used.

livePostFooter.label: 🔴 Live Post Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
livePostFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the live post.
livePostFooter.placeholder: Optional - appended below the live post (Discord, socials, rules…)

liveSidebarText.label: 🔴 Live Sidebar Widget Text (Markdown) (Optional)
liveSidebarText.helpText: Custom markdown for the body of the sidebar widget when the stream is live. If empty, the default template is used.

liveSidebarFooter.label: 🔴 Live Sidebar Widget Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
liveSidebarFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the sidebar widget when the stream is live.
liveSidebarFooter.placeholder: Optional - appended below the live sidebar widget

liveCommentText.label: 🔴 Auto-Pinned Comment Text (Optional)
liveCommentText.helpText: Text to automatically post and pin as a mod comment inside the live post (e.g. Discord link).
liveCommentText.placeholder: Optional - pinned mod comment (Discord link, rules…)

enableDynamicFlair.label: 🔧 Enable Dynamic Post Flair Updates
enableDynamicFlair.helpText: Periodically updates the live post (or dashboard post) flair with active game and live viewers (e.g. 🔴 LIVE: Just Chatting [15.4K]).

liveFlairId.label: 🔧 Live Post Flair Template ID (Optional)
liveFlairId.helpText: The UUID of the flair template to apply to the live post (from Mod Tools ➔ Post Flair)

offlineGracePeriod.label: 😴 Offline Grace Period (Minutes)
offlineGracePeriod.helpText: How long (in minutes) to wait before concluding the live post after going offline. Prevents duplicate posts during brief stream crashes.

removeOfflinePost.label: 😴 Remove Live Post from Feed when Offline
removeOfflinePost.helpText: Mod action: Hides the live post from the community feed when offline. It remains accessible via direct links or comment histories without cluttering the feed.

deleteOfflinePost.label: 😴 Delete Live Post when Offline
deleteOfflinePost.helpText: Completely deletes the live post and all its comments when the stream ends.

stickyOfflinePost.label: 😴 Enable Pinned Offline Post
stickyOfflinePost.helpText: Recycles a single permanent pinned post when offline to announce news and useful links. The post is unpinned when live and pinned again when offline. Because it is recycled, users are never notified of a new post after creation.

offlineFlairText.label: 😴 Offline Flair Text (Optional)
offlineFlairText.helpText: Text to set as the post flair when the stream goes offline. Defaults to '⚫ OFFLINE' if left empty.

offlinePostTitle.label: 😴 Offline Post Title (Optional)
offlinePostTitle.helpText: Custom title for the offline post. If empty, the default template is used.

offlinePostBody.label: 😴 Offline Post Body (Markdown) (Optional)
offlinePostBody.helpText: Custom markdown for the body of the offline post. If empty, the default template is used.
offlinePostBody.defaultValue:
The stream is currently offline. Check back soon or follow the channels below to get notified when {display_name} goes live!

---
**Watch the VODs on:**

🟪 **[Twitch]({twitch_url})**  •  🟥 **[YouTube]({youtube_url})**  •  🟩 **[Kick]({kick_url})**

offlinePostFooter.label: 😴 Offline Post Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
offlinePostFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the offline post.
offlinePostFooter.placeholder: Optional - appended below the offline post (Discord, socials, rules…)

offlineSidebarText.label: 😴 Offline Sidebar Widget Text (Markdown) (Optional)
offlineSidebarText.helpText: Custom markdown for the body of the sidebar widget when the stream is offline. If empty, the default template is used.
offlineSidebarText.defaultValue:
# 😴 {display_name} is offline 😴

Follow the channels below to get notified when {display_name} goes live!

---
**Watch the VODs on:**

🟪 **[Twitch]({twitch_url})**  •  🟥 **[YouTube]({youtube_url})**  •  🟩 **[Kick]({kick_url})**

offlineSidebarFooter.label: 😴 Offline Sidebar Widget Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
offlineSidebarFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the offline sidebar widget.
offlineSidebarFooter.placeholder: Optional - appended below the offline sidebar widget

concludingPostBody.label: 🎬 Concluding Post Body (Markdown) (Optional)
concludingPostBody.helpText: Custom markdown for the live post body after the stream ends. If empty, the default template is used.
concludingPostBody.defaultValue:
### 👋 Stream Ended - Thanks for watching! 👋

**Title:**
{title}

The stream has concluded. VODs and highlights may be available via the links below.

---
**Watch the VODs on:**

🟪 **[Twitch]({twitch_url})**  •  🟥 **[YouTube]({youtube_url})**  •  🟩 **[Kick]({kick_url})**

---
*This post is now locked as the stream has ended.*

concludingPostFooter.label: 🎬 Concluding Post Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
concludingPostFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the concluding post.
concludingPostFooter.placeholder: Optional - appended below the concluding post

enableHighlightsPost.label: 🎬 Enable Stream Highlights Post
enableHighlightsPost.helpText: Automatically posts a compilation of top Twitch clips generated during the stream when it ends.

highlightsFlairId.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Flair Template ID (Optional)
highlightsFlairId.helpText: The UUID of the flair template to apply to the stream highlights post (from Mod Tools ➔ Post Flair).

highlightsPostTitle.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Title (Optional)
highlightsPostTitle.helpText: Custom title for the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.

highlightsHeader.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Custom Header (Markdown) (Optional)
highlightsHeader.helpText: Custom markdown for the header of the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.

highlightsFooter.label: 🎬 Highlights Post Custom Footer (Markdown) (Optional)
highlightsFooter.helpText: Custom markdown to append at the bottom of the stream highlights post. If empty, the default template is used.
highlightsFooter.defaultValue:
---
*Watch VODs and catch the next stream live on [twitch.tv/{channel}](https://twitch.tv/{channel})!*
